overrides.reason: The oracle's fixtures write these on purpose, to hold native code to what Node does where a program does them: a value compared with itself and with NaN (NaN !== NaN), a value assigned to itself, and a loop whose body always leaves it.
objects.a tests a switch on a union that names some members and leaves the rest to default, and one that names only some and falls out the bottom for the rest, as JavaScript allows.
